verdict.rationale: Pylon documents its agents running standalone inside Pylon's own ticketing: issues are tracked across channels and assigned to the AI agent. Its Salesforce integration pushes AI conversation summaries one way onto Salesforce Accounts and maps accounts between the systems, but it does not sync tickets. Nothing in the evidence shows the agent running inside Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud or Intercom, or two-way ticket sync with any external helpdesk. missing for 10: agent embedded in Zendesk/Intercom/Salesforce helpdesks, bidirectional ticket sync with external helpdesks, two-way context sync (Salesforce sync is one-way summaries), independent corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, the agent runs inside my existing helpdesk — Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom — or standalone, syncing tickets and context both ways

citations.quote: Track customer issues across any channel (Slack Connect, Email, Microsoft Teams, Chat Widget, Forms, ...) and orchestrate agents to investigate and act on your customer issues.
You can also assign an individual issue to your AI agent, the same way you might normally assign an issue to a team member.
For every conversation, we use AI to summarize the details, and sync the summary to the relevant Account in Salesforce.
Accounts are mapped using domain and name matching between Salesforce and Pylon by default.
